summary: Increased right lung airspace opacity and a larger left pleural effusion are seen on the current radiograph.

findings.rationale: Patchy-to-confluent airspace opacity now involves much of the right mid to lower lung; asymmetry favors worsening consolidation over projection alone.
The left retrocardiac/basal veiling opacity is greater, consistent with a larger left pleural effusion though adjacent collapse may contribute.
